name: bridge
description: App de desktop para Windows que roda vários agentes de código lado a lado, com integração de hooks do Claude Code, worktree por tarefa e CLI.
author: Erick Dantas

scripts.dev:app: npm run build -w @bridge/shell && set BRIDGE_DEV=1&& electron packages/shell
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bridge/ui && npm run build -w @bridge/core && npm run build -w @bridge/cli && npm run build -w @bridge/shell
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @bridge/shell
scripts.e2e: npm run build:ui && npm run build:cli && npm run build -w @bridge/shell && npx playwright test -c packages/shell/playwright.config.ts
